fusions.name: Barrel Through
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 6 tiles to the target and drives a shoulder into it, dealing 14 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Pried Open
fusions.desc: Bursts open the guard of every enemy within 3.5 tiles and deals 28 damage to each. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Heavy Hand, Light Step
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Jar Lid Pop
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
